d:
Navada ke varisliganj ke gaurakshani ke pas tabartor phayring se ilake men macha harkanp, donon ghaylon ko behtar ilaj ke lie kiya gaya rephar
Navada ke varisliganj men tabartor golibari, do log ganbhir rup se jakhmi
Gaurakshani ke pas phayring se ilake men machi aphra-taphri, donon ghaylon ko lagi goli
Pulis ki tvarit karravaee, goli marne ke aarop men do log giraphtar; varchasv ko lekar vivad ki aashanka
